key_points: $5.5B talc litigation proposal removes a multi-year legal overhang, materially de-risking the equity.
Apollo reportedly weighing $20B takeover of DePuy Synthes orthopaedics unit signals meaningful value-unlock optionality in MedTech.
Management reiterated double-digit growth trajectory through decade-end despite STELARA biosimilar erosion.
Small pipeline miss (Contineum/JNJ-5120 in MDD) is immaterial to the broader thesis.
Third-party valuation models flag rich multiples (~37% overvalued), but this is noise vs. event-driven catalysts.
